description: Defines the WebmMuxer class for creating WebM media containers, including nested Delegate class for writing data, and methods for adding encoded video/audio frames, managing tracks, and flushing data. It is part of the media muxing subsystem in Chromium.

classes.name: WebmMuxer
classes.description: Handles creation of WebM media containers, manages encoding frames, tracks, and data output timing.

classes.name: WebmMuxer::Delegate
classes.description: Interface for writing WebM data, supporting initialization and data writing.

classes.name: WebmMuxer::EncodedFrame
classes.description: Represents an encoded media frame with associated metadata.

classes.name: WebmMuxer::MonotonicTimestampSequence
classes.description: Ensures monotonically increasing timestamps for media frames.

methods.name: SetMaximumDurationToForceDataOutput
methods.description: Sets maximum interval to force data output during muxing.

methods.name: OnEncodedVideo
methods.description: Adds an encoded video frame to the muxer.

methods.name: OnEncodedAudio
methods.description: Adds an encoded audio frame to the muxer.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Finalizes and writes all buffered data.

methods.name: ForceOneLibWebmErrorForTesting
methods.description: Forces an error for testing purposes.

methods.name: AddVideoTrack
methods.description: Creates a video track with specified parameters.

methods.name: AddAudioTrack
methods.description: Creates an audio track with specified parameters.

methods.name: FlushQueues
methods.description: Flushes buffered frames in timestamp order.

methods.name: PartiallyFlushQueues
methods.description: Flushes frames while maintaining timestamp monotonicity.

methods.name: FlushNextFrame
methods.description: Flushes the next frame in timestamp order.

methods.name: MaybeForceNewCluster
methods.description: Forces creation of a new data cluster based on timing.
